minmax.note: MathF.Max/MathF.Min; rows are [x_bits, y_bits, max_bits, min_bits]

float_int.note: rows are [x_bits, trunc (int)x, round_to_even, round_away, floor, ceil]; MathF.Round returns float, results cast to int

denormal.note: f32 bits: inputs a, b and a+b, a*b, a*0.5, a/2, b-a, sqrt(a)

idm.note: rows are f32 bits [amax, b, T, s0, delta, max_speed, speed_factor, lane_limit, v, gap, dv, v0 = Idm.DesiredSpeed, a = Idm.Accel]; delta in {4, 2}
